This episode of Abandoned in pushes us past our comfort zones in every way - and we partnered with Brooks Running to help us take that leap. The Brooks Glycerin Flex is built for softness and support when you’re stepping into the unknown, physically or mentally.
Thank you to the incredible for being such a champion. After years, she finally proved that a Yes Theory challenge, with the right energy, intention and of course mindful precautions, is in fact available to all. Hope you all enjoyed this wild ride :)
